limits.comment: Synthetic visuals: procedural motion graphics rendered from code. Generated media: AI-generated voice (Kokoro-82M v1.0, voice af_heart, run locally), disclosed in MP4 metadata and deliverables; not a person. Four multi-section instrumental stems generated locally from text prompts with Meta MusicGen (facebook/musicgen-small), EQ-notched at 1850 Hz for speech clarity and lookahead-ducked under narration. Motion graphics rendered from code by this video's stage; example data on screen is synthetic. Narration is an AI-generated voice (Kokoro-82M v1.0, voice af_heart), disclosed in file metadata and delivery manifests. Background underscore is synthesized locally with Meta MusicGen (facebook/musicgen-small) across four acts, EQ-notched and ducked under the voice. Interface shots are real captures: the live public pages of eranos.ta-amps.workers.dev and agora.ta-amps.workers.dev, and a local Eranos and Tessera run with scripted agents and synthetic data. The reveal board shows what the local production Tessera store held when the board was composed; the render and check receipts were written after it.
